flavorText: A heavily armed Terran Grid patrol is locking down the sector ahead. Floodlights sweep the pavement, and their hounds are sniffing the air for unfamiliar occult signatures.
A localized Veil-tear is violently leaking raw Resonance, warping the concrete and sealing the blast doors shut.
The path is blocked by a massive, rusted Legion weapons cache. The lock is rigged to a dead-man's switch, vibrating violently.
The primary terminal is locked behind a lethal, biometric firewall. Attempting to force the connection will trigger a localized kinetic shockwave.
A ruptured industrial valve is venting highly caustic, Veil-tainted gas into the corridor. The air itself is rapidly becoming corrosive to flesh and metal.
The physical space is folding in on itself. A labyrinth of shifting ley-lines has trapped you, and the Veil is actively trying to drain your life force.
A brutalized Legion vanguard has set up a makeshift toll ahead. Their heavy weapons are spun up, and chained spectral entities patrol their perimeter.
The room is rigged with a dense network of Solaris blood-wards. Ethereal tripwires crisscross the area, ready to detonate raw occult energy if disturbed.
The area is choked by a localized Memory Bleed. Ethereal echoes of a violent, historical massacre are looping continuously, threatening to drag your consciousness into the nightmare.
A massive, starving Abyssal entity is tearing apart a rusted transit vehicle ahead. It hasn't noticed you yet, but the only path forward is directly through its hunting ground.
A localized Veil-distortion is warping the structural supports. The supernatural gravity is pulling the ceiling down, threatening to crush everything in the corridor.
A Solaris purger-squad is conducting a brutal blood-rite in the center of the room. They are highly alert and sealing the exits with volatile ash-wards.
A hidden, automated Terran Grid kinetic-sentry has deployed from the masonry, its targeting laser cutting through the dark and scanning for unauthorized biometric signatures.
